examples.knowledge_point: Evaluating Repeated Integrals Over Non-Rectangular Domains
examples.worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $z,$ treating $x$ and $y$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}{\int }_{0}^{3-x-y}x\,dz\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}[{\int }_{0}^{3-x-y}x\,dz]dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}x\cdot [z]_{z=0}^{z=3-x-y}\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}x(3-x-y)\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}3x-{x}^{2}-xy\,dy\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y,$ treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}3x-{x}^{2}-xy\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{x}3x-{x}^{2}-xy\,dy]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{[(3x-{x}^{2})y-\frac{1}{2}x{y}^{2}]}_{y=0}^{y=x}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}(3x-{x}^{2})(x-0)-\frac{1}{2}x({x}^{2}-0)\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}3{x}^{2}-{x}^{3}-\frac{1}{2}{x}^{3}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}3{x}^{2}-\frac{3}{2}{x}^{3}\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}3{x}^{2}-\frac{3}{2}{x}^{3}\,dx & ={[{x}^{3}-\frac{3}{8}{x}^{4}]}_{x=0}^{x=2} \\  & =8-6 \\  & =2\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y$, treating $x$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{\int }_{0}^{3}{e}^{z}({y}^{2}-x)\,dy\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}[{\int }_{0}^{3}{e}^{z}{y}^{2}-{e}^{z}x\,dy]dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{e}^{z}{[\frac{{y}^{3}}{3}]}_{y=0}^{y=3}-x{e}^{z}[y]_{y=0}^{y=3}\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{e}^{z}(9-0)-x{e}^{z}(3-0)\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}9{e}^{z}-3x{e}^{z}\,dz\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $z$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}9{e}^{z}-3x{e}^{z}\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{1}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{e}^{z}(9-3x)\,dz]dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}(9-3x)[{e}^{z}]_{z=0}^{z=\operatorname{ln}⁡2}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}(9-3x)(2-1)\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}9-3x\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}9-3x\,dx & ={[9x-\frac{3{x}^{2}}{2}]}_{x=1}^{x=2} \\  & =(18-6)-(9-\frac{3}{2}) \\  & =\frac{9}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
